sections.description_of_main_ingredients:
Kaant loha Bhasma – This is an Ayurvedic mineral-based formulation which is prepared from Iron oxide. This formulation is useful in iron deficiency anemia, general debility, jaundice, IBS etc. 
 Dhaturaghan Sar – Dhatura has analgesic effect. It is useful in reducing pain in various diseases. It is also beneficial in kustha and acts as deepana and pachana. 
 Ras – sindoor – It is a formulation which is made from herbal and mineral ingredients. It is used in Ayurveda for the treatment of various diseases. It improves strength of the body and also improves immunity. 
 Jaiphal Churna – This is used as a medicine for abdominal diseases, skin diseases, indigestion, Fever etc. It acts as purgative. 
 Trikatu Churna – This powder is made from three herbs such as Pippali ( Piper longum ), Maricha ( Piper nigrum ) and Shunthi ( Zingiber officinale ). These herbs are for the treatment of gastric problems. These improve digestion by stimulating the digestive fire. 

 Method of Preparation 

 Properly mix Ras-Sindoor in a kharal yantra. 
 Add the rest of the ingredients in this Ras-Sindoor. 
 Give 7 Bhavna with the extracts of Dronapushpi ( Leucas cephalotes ) and Tambulpatra (Betel leaf). 
 Make 125 mg tablets and let them dry. 
 Keep these tablets in a glass container. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Kasturi Bhairav rasa (Madhyam) is an Ayurvedic formulation. This herbo-mineral composition has various benefits which aids in treating many diseases such as diabetes, indigestion, Fever, recurrent abortion etc. The ingredients in this formulation are best for enhancing digestive fire.

Kasturi Bhairav Rasa (Madhyam) 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Jwaradhikar 160/797 
 Introduction 
 Kasturi Bhairav rasa (Madhyam) is an ancient formulation which is used in various diseases like diabetes, anemia, malaria, dengue and some respiratory disorders. This is a herbo-mineral composition. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Kaant Loha Bhasma ( Magnetic Iron Calx ) – 4 Parts 
 Dhaturaghan Sar ( Datura metel ) – 2 Parts 
 Ras-Sindoor ( Mercury based Ayurvedic preparation ) – 2 Parts 
 Lavang Churna ( Syzygium aromaticum ) – 2 Parts 
 Jaiphal Churna ( Myristica fragrans ) – 2 Parts 
 Trikatu Churna ( Powder of three Herbs) – 2 Parts 
 Kapoor ( Cinnamomum camphora ) – 2 Parts 
 Vanga Bhasma – 1 Part 
 Kharpara Bhasma – 1 Part 
 Kasturi ( Abelmoschus moschatus ) – 1 Part 
 Swarna Bhasma ( Gold ash ) – 1 Part 
 Chandi Bhasma ( Silver ash ) – 1 Part 
 
 Description of Main Ingredients 
 
 Kaant loha Bhasma – This is an Ayurvedic mineral-based formulation which is prepared from Iron oxide. This formulation is useful in iron deficiency anemia, general debility, jaundice, IBS etc. 
 Dhaturaghan Sar – Dhatura has analgesic effect. It is useful in reducing pain in various diseases. It is also beneficial in kustha and acts as deepana and pachana. 
 Ras – sindoor – It is a formulation which is made from herbal and mineral ingredients. It is used in Ayurveda for the treatment of various diseases. It improves strength of the body and also improves immunity. 
 Jaiphal Churna – This is used as a medicine for abdominal diseases, skin diseases, indigestion, Fever etc. It acts as purgative. 
 Trikatu Churna – This powder is made from three herbs such as Pippali ( Piper longum ), Maricha ( Piper nigrum ) and Shunthi ( Zingiber officinale ). These herbs are for the treatment of gastric problems. These improve digestion by stimulating the digestive fire. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Properly mix Ras-Sindoor in a kharal yantra. 
 Add the rest of the ingredients in this Ras-Sindoor. 
 Give 7 Bhavna with the extracts of Dronapushpi ( Leucas cephalotes ) and Tambulpatra (Betel leaf). 
 Make 125 mg tablets and let them dry. 
 Keep these tablets in a glass container. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Kasturi Bhairav rasa (Madhyam) is an Ayurvedic formulation. This herbo-mineral composition has various benefits which aids in treating many diseases such as diabetes, indigestion, Fever, recurrent abortion etc. The ingredients in this formulation are best for enhancing digestive fire. 
 Indications 
 
 Fever 
 Recurrent abortion 
 Diabetes 
 Malaria 
 Dengue 
 Cough 
 Dyspnea 
 Edema 
 
 Dosage 
 1 tablet twice a day with the extracts of Adraka ( Zingiber officinale ) or honey. 
 Cautions 
 
 Avoid in pregnancy and lactating mother. 
 It should be taken under medical supervision. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
